intl.title: UW-Superior - How to apply: international students (English proficiency, deadlines, fees)

test_policy.notes: The international page says SAT or ACT scores are encouraged but not required for admission.

requirements.notes: Apply with the UW System application. There is no application fee, but a $50 International Admissions Processing Service (IAPS) fee is required after submitting. Needs official (or clear scans of official) secondary records with literal English translations, English proficiency evidence, a financial verification form with bank documents covering the first year, and a passport copy; the written statement is preferred but optional. No minimum GPA is published for international first-year applicants. Decisions take about 2-3 weeks after all documents arrive.

deadlines.label: Preferred deadline, fall 2027 (international)
deadlines.notes: Page prints May 1 as the preferred fall deadline with no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. Spring term: preferred October 1, final November 15. Students in F-1 status in the U.S. are considered after the deadline case by case.

deadlines.label: Final deadline, fall 2027 (international)
deadlines.notes: Applications and all required materials must arrive by 11:59 PM Central Time. No year is printed, so fall 2027 is assumed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: International applicants educated primarily outside the U.S. must show proficiency, except applicants primarily educated in a listed English-speaking country, three years at a U.S. (or U.S.-accredited) high school with a diploma, or a U.S. degree or two years at a U.S. college. UW-Superior may require evidence from any applicant. Other accepted measures: SAT ERW 470, ACT English 18, MET 69, TOEFL paper 500, iTEP Academic 4.0, Cambridge C1/C2 pass, and partner language programs (ELS level 110, FLS level 16, TLC level 9, WESLI recommendation). Depending on scores, students may take a combination of ESL and non-ESL courses in the first semester. Online undergraduate programs need higher scores (IELTS 6.5, TOEFL 80, Duolingo 115).

english.notes: TOEFL MyBest also accepted at 61 (minimum single test date score 56).
New scale: 3.5 overall with writing 3.0 or higher.
B2 First 169; C1 Advanced and C2 Proficiency accepted with a pass.

aid.notes: Nonresident Tuition Waiver (NTW): automatic for qualifying international degree-seeking undergraduates, no separate application; more than 90 percent of international students receive it. First-year GPA 2.90-3.39 waives $5,900 per year (tuition and fees then $12,255); GPA 3.40+ (NTW Scholar) waives $8,100 per year ($10,055). Renewable up to four years. Separately, two #YouAreWelcomeHere scholarships of $8,400 per year are awarded each fall (GPA 3.5+, separate application, cannot be combined with NTW). No need-based aid for international students is described.
